title: 第6章 换血？
content_zh:
第6章换血？
胡万很有钱。
这是杨狱对这位胡师兄的第一印象。
黑山外城有三大城区，每个城区有一屠户，胡万正是他所在城区的屠夫。
不但自个魁梧的好似一头毛熊，手下二三十个伙计，也都膀大腰圆、孔武有力。
就算是外城的一些小帮派也都不敢招惹他们。
“嘿！”
刚出内城大门，杨狱就听得自家这位胡师兄闷笑一声：“杨师弟，你这是被盯上了啊？”
“王六。”
那几人堂而皇之的蹲守在这里，杨狱自然也看得到，而且还认得。
几人里个子最高的那个，叫王六，是那日去他家的那个妇人的姘头，平日里打鸡骂狗，是他们那块有名的混不吝。
“瞧着！”
胡万‘嘿嘿’一笑，敞开嗓子就叫住了准备开溜的几个混子：“孙子，过来爷爷这！”
王六几人身子都是一僵，扭过头，脸色比哭还难看：“王六见过胡大哥……”
“大哥也是你叫的？”
话没说完，胡万蒲扇也似的大手已然盖在王六脸上，鼻血混着牙齿飞了出去：
“叫胡爷！”
“哎呦喂~”
王六被一下打趴，哭喊着嚎了起来：“胡，胡爷，你，你为啥打我？”
“咋？爷爷打不得你？”

胡万又是一脚，王六咕噜噜的滚了几圈，只觉眼前发黑，差点被一脚踢死。
其余几个混子看的两股战战，别说上了，跑都不敢跑。
他们也就欺负一下老实人，遇到胡万这样的大屠户，哪里硬气的起来？
“爷爷，胡爷爷，别，别打了……”
王六被打懵了，趴在地上不住求饶，裤裆都湿了一大片。
“猪狗一样的东西，也敢吃人绝户？”
胡万一脸嫌恶，发黄的浓痰吐了王六一脸，又一脚将其踹的飞起：
“滚你娘的！”
王六一阵呻吟，却是连爬也爬不起来了。
被两个混子架着，惨嚎着狼狈而去。
“谢谢胡师兄。”
杨狱忙抱拳道谢，心中也觉解气。
“谢个什么？俺也就帮你这一时，这种猪狗样的东西最是难缠，要想解决，还得看你自己。”
胡万一摆手：“要谢，就谢老头子吧。”
杨狱点点头，心中也是提起小心。
他与胡万不过见过几面，这次出手也是因为魏河嘱咐，要想解决威胁，还是得看自己。
“倒也不用太担心。”
见杨狱不说话，胡万又道：“这些混子多半家贫，靠着个狠字厮混。等你练个几天，他们就不敢招惹你了。”
一路走着，杨狱也没放过这个机会，向胡万请教着刀法技巧，也打听着外城的一些事情。
待得走过几条街道，快到广场之时，胡万突然止步，拉着杨狱就转进了一条小巷。

“嗯？”
杨狱一愣，随即看到广场上不知什么时候竖起一个高台，一个看上去仙风道骨的老道，在念叨着什么。
高台下，一大群人或站或坐，他们有老有少、有男有女，却都不发一声，看上去极为诡异。
“这外城待不得了，待不得了……”
胡万嘴里念叨着，脸色有些不好看：“你娘的，连老子的弟兄都被拉进去了。”
“邪门，邪门！”
胡万连道两个邪门，拉着杨狱就绕路，却是连照面都不敢打。
“胡师兄很怕这怜生教？”
杨狱心中一动。
这大半年里，他还是第一次见到有人嫌恶怜生教的，其余人，包括他婆婆在内，都觉得这个教派治病救人，是个善教。
久而久之，他都差点以为自己太多疑了。
此时见胡万满脸惧色，忍不住发问。
“老子会怕他？”
胡万脸色一沉，矢口否认，扫过四周，才压低声音道：“这怜生教，很邪门！”
“他们不是治病救人的吗？”
杨狱佯做不懂。
“烧几张符就能治病救人？有着本事，不去给皇帝老子效力，跑来给咱们这些苦哈哈看病？”
胡万‘嘿嘿’冷笑几声，道：
“咱们外城今年因病而死的人，可比往年三五年还多，还都是年轻人。呵呵……”
说到这里，胡万突然住口，杨狱猛然抬头，才见得小巷外，一个穿的好似披麻戴孝样的白衣人带着一队人经过。

为首的，还扫了一眼胡万。
“好险……”
胡万大喘气，额头有着汗珠，见杨狱眼神古怪，又很是有些气恼：
“要不是老子前些日子才‘换血’，早就操刀带人把这鸟教派干翻了！”
杨狱本是好奇发问，听得胡万的话，顿时捕捉到了重要的点：
“换血？”
“你不知道？对了，你才入门。”
胡万擦去额头冷汗，一时也不想动弹了，索性靠着墙稍歇：
“咱们练武，不管是刀枪还是拳脚，说到底，还是看谁速度快，力量大。可身体打磨到一定程度，再想增加，就得‘换血’了。”
换血……
听着胡万的话，杨狱眼神发亮。
此时，他回想起来，胡万人高马大不假，可那王六也是七尺汉子，可被胡万打儿子似的暴打没有还手之力。
而胡万两百斤的身子，魏老头一只手就提起来了，当时有些吃惊，此时却有些恍然。
原来是换血。
“师兄，怎么才能换血？”
杨狱询问。
“你想换血？你知道换血得吃多少药材？俺爹杀了三十年的猪，俺又杀了十多年，就这，
一次换血，还差点拉了饥荒，就你……”
胡万连连摇头：
“穷文富武，你以为说说而已？”

杨狱没说话，只是捏了捏口袋里的石子。
没药材，石头大概，也行？
“行了行了，这些事，你还是问老头子吧。”
见杨狱还要发问，胡万顿感有些头大，摆摆手，就出了小巷。
“换血、换血……”
杨狱翻来覆去咀嚼着这两个字，心中生出莫大的渴望来。
这种世道，真真是靠人不如靠自己。
若自己实力强大，那王六也似的泼皮哪里敢来吃自家的绝户？
临近傍晚，送走了草草吃了几口的胡万，杨狱合上门，提着个布袋来到了厨房。
起锅烧水，然后将满满几袋子挑选好的‘石子’倒进了锅里蒸煮。
翻来覆去的洗了好多遍，才空了水，捞起来装好，提着回到了房间。
“不就是吃石头？”
“吃！”
杨狱将门窗关好，又将蒸煮好的石子一袋袋的摆在床头，才合衣躺在床上，闭上眼。
咬着牙呼唤起了‘暴食之鼎’。
“炼化！”
邮寄合同，稍微晚了点。
content_en:
Chapter 6: Blood exchange?
Hu Wan is very rich.
This was Yang Yu's first impression of Senior Brother Hu.
There are three major districts in the outer city of Heishan, and each district has a butcher. Hu Wan is the butcher in his district.
Not only is he as tall as a bear, but the twenty or thirty men under his command are also muscular and muscular.
Even some small gangs in the outer city dare not provoke them.
"Hey!"
As soon as he left the gate of the inner city, Yang Yu heard his senior brother Hu chuckle: "Junior brother Yang, are you being targeted?"
"Wang Liu."
Those few people were squatting here in a dignified manner. Yang Yu could naturally see and recognize them.
The tallest one among them, Wang Liu, was the mistress of the woman who went to his house that day. She was a well-known gangster in their area who usually beat chickens and scolded dogs.
"Look!"
Hu Wan smiled "hehe" and opened his voice to stop a few gangsters who were about to run away: "Grandson, come here, grandpa!"
Wang Liu and others froze, turned their heads, their faces uglier than crying: "Wang Liu has seen Brother Hu..."
"Is that what you call me brother?"
Before he finished speaking, Hu Wan's big hand like a fan covered Wang Liu's face, and the nosebleed mixed with his teeth flew out:
"Call Mr. Hu!"
"Hey~"
Wang Liu was beaten to the ground and started to cry and howl: "Hu, Mr. Hu, you, why did you hit me?"
"What? Grandpa can't beat you?"
Hu Wan kicked him again, and Wang Liu rolled around a few times. His vision turned black and he was almost kicked to death.
The other gangsters were watching the fight between the two groups, and they didn't even dare to run away, let alone get on.
They just bully honest people. How can they be so tough when they encounter a big butcher like Hu Wan?
"Grandpa, Grandpa Hu, don't, don't fight..."
Wang Liu was stunned. He lay on the ground and kept begging for mercy. His crotch was all wet.
"Things like pigs and dogs dare to eat people to death?"
Hu Wan looked disgusted and spat yellow phlegm on Wang Liu's face, then kicked him into the air:
"Get out of here, motherfucker!"
Wang Liu groaned for a while, but he couldn't even get up.
He was held up by two gangsters and left in embarrassment, howling miserably.
"Thank you, Senior Brother Hu."
Yang Yu hurriedly cupped his fists to say thank you, feeling relieved in his heart.
"Thank you for what? I will only help you for a moment. Things like pigs and dogs are the most difficult to deal with. If you want to solve them, you have to look at yourself."
Hu Wanyi waved his hand: "If you want to thank me, just thank the old man."
Yang Yu nodded, but he was also careful in his heart.
He had only met Hu Wan a few times, and the reason he took action this time was because Wei He told him that if he wanted to solve the threat, he still had to look to himself.
"Don't worry too much."
Seeing that Yang Yu didn't speak, Hu Wan said again: "Most of these gangsters are from poor families, and they rely on being ruthless to get around. After you practice for a few days, they won't dare to provoke you."
Along the way, Yang Yu did not miss this opportunity, asking Hu Wan for sword skills and asking about some things in the outer city.
After walking through a few streets and approaching the square, Hu Wan suddenly stopped and pulled Yang Yu into an alley.
"Huh?"
Yang Yu was stunned for a moment, and then he saw a high platform erected in the square at some point, and an old Taoist who looked like an immortal was talking about something.
Under the high platform, a large group of people were standing or sitting. They were old and young, male and female, but they didn't say a word. They looked extremely strange.
"I can't wait in this outer city anymore, I can't wait anymore..."
Hu Wan muttered, his face a little ugly: "Damn it, even my brothers were dragged in."
"Evil door, evil door!"
Hu Wan attacked two evil sects and took Yang Yu out of the way, but he didn't even dare to confront them.
"Senior Brother Hu is afraid of this Lianshengjiao?"
Yang Yu's heart moved.
In the past half year, this was the first time he had seen someone dislike the Liansheng Sect. Others, including his mother-in-law, felt that this sect was a good religion because it healed diseases and saved people.
Over timeAfter all, he almost thought he was too suspicious.
At this time, seeing Hu Wan's face full of fear, he couldn't help but ask questions.
"Will I be afraid of him?"
Hu Wan's face darkened and he denied it. He glanced around and then lowered his voice and said, "This Liansheng Cult is very evil!"
"Don't they treat illnesses and save lives?"
Yang Yu pretended not to understand.
"Can you cure diseases and save people by burning a few talismans? You have the ability, but instead of working for the emperor, you come to treat us miserable people?"
Hu Wan sneered "hehe" and said:
"There are more people in our outer city dying of illness this year than in the past three to five years, and they are all young people. Haha..."
At this point, Hu Wan suddenly stopped, and Yang Yu suddenly raised his head, only to see a man in white clothes passing by with a group of people outside the alley.
The leader also glanced at Hu Wan.
"It's so dangerous..."
Hu Wan was panting heavily, with beads of sweat on his forehead. Seeing Yang Yu's strange eyes, he felt a little annoyed:
"If I hadn't changed my mind a few days ago, I would have killed the Bird Sect long ago!"
Yang Yu originally asked out of curiosity, but after hearing Hu Wan's words, he immediately caught the important point:
"Exchange blood?"
"You don't know? By the way, you are just getting started."
Hu Wan wiped the cold sweat from his forehead and didn't want to move for a while. He simply leaned against the wall to rest for a while:
"We practice martial arts, whether it's swords, guns or fists and kicks. In the end, it's all about who is faster and stronger. But after your body has been polished to a certain level, if you want to increase it, you have to 'replace it'."
Blood transfusion...
Listening to Hu Wan's words, Yang Yu's eyes lit up.
At this time, he recalled that it was true that Hu Wan was tall and powerful, but Wang Liu was also a man of seven feet, but he was beaten by Hu Wan like a son and had no strength to fight back.
As for Hu Wan's two-hundred-pound body, Old Man Wei lifted it up with one hand. He was a little surprised at the time, but now he felt a little enlightened.
It turned out to be a blood transfusion.
"Brother, how can I exchange blood?"
Yang Yu asked.
"You want blood transfusion? Do you know how many medicinal materials are needed for blood transfusion? My father has been killing pigs for thirty years, and I have been killing pigs for more than ten years. This is it.
A blood exchange almost caused famine, but you..."
Hu Wan shook his head repeatedly:
"We are poor in literature and rich in martial arts, do you think it's just talk?"
Yang Yu didn't say anything, just pinched the pebbles in his pocket.
If there are no medicinal materials, maybe stones will do?
"Okay, okay, you'd better ask the old man about these things."
Seeing that Yang Yu wanted to ask questions, Hu Wandun felt a little dizzy, waved his hand and walked out of the alley.
"Exchange blood, exchange blood..."
Yang Yu chewed these two words over and over again, feeling a great desire in his heart.
In this kind of world, it is really better to rely on yourself than to rely on others.
If he was strong, how could a rogue like Wang Liu dare to eat his own family?
Near evening, after sending Hu Wan away after eating a few hastily, Yang Yu closed the door and came to the kitchen carrying a cloth bag.
Boil water in a pot, then pour several bags full of selected ‘stones’ into the pot to cook.
After washing it over and over again, it was empty of water, picked it up, packed it, and carried it back to the room.
"Isn't it just eating rocks?"
"Eat!"
Yang Prison closed the doors and windows, and placed bags of boiled stones on the bedside, then put on his clothes and lay down on the bed, closing his eyes.
Gritting his teeth, he called for the ‘Cauldron of Gluttony’.
"Refining!"
The contract was mailed, a little late.
